facts.text: Serve the shawarma during the end credits, when the team eats in silence.
facts.why: The team eating shawarma in silence is the post-credits scene, after the whole credits. The mid-credits scene is the Other talking to Thanos.
facts.fix: Serve the shawarma after the credits, when the team eats in silence.

facts.text: Drinks at the top of the tower, before Loki arrives.
facts.why: The plot summary has no drinks scene. It only has Loki opening the portal above Stark Tower. Could not confirm a drinks scene before Loki arrives.
facts.fix: Stark Tower, where Loki opens the portal over Manhattan.

vibe.verdict: Good takeaway look and the shawarma payoff, but only a few of the film's big moments make it onto the sheet.
missing: Hulk smashing Loki about (the 'puny god' moment)
Tony catching the nuke and falling back to Earth
Hawkeye on his perch over the city
ideas: Swap 'Asgardian honey roasted nuts' for a 'Puny god' dessert shot that is smashed on the plate.
Swap the Stark Tower tuna bite note for 'Tony's bar, where Loki gets offered a drink'. Check the scene first.
Add a Coulson trading card cookie in a bag as the Movie Night For Two extra.
Keep the shawarma as the closing line, but make the tip say 'after the credits'.
